content.title: About - RocketLaunch.Live
content.text: At RocketLaunch.Live, we are dedicated to being the most up-to-date and accurate source of information about orbital rocket launches worldwide. Never again wonder when or where to watch the next rocket launch! You can always head to our main page for live coverage of the active launch at any given time. RocketLaunch.Live Premium This website is made possible by the support of our RocketLaunch.Live Premium Members! If you like our site, please consider becoming a monthly supporter. You'll gain advanced and/or exclusive access to new features and help offset our operational and development costs! Contact Special Thanks RocketLaunch.Live's data is derived and curated from many different sources, with special thanks to Jonathan McDowell for his priceless catalogue of historical launch information, which provided the foundation for our launch data prior to 2017. Disclaimer The information and data provided by RocketLaunch.Live are for informational purposes only and comes with no guarantees or warranties with respect to accuracy. All information is subject to change. We do our best to find the most recent and accurate information, but you should always verify via other sources before taking action. Your usage of RocketLaunch.Live is governed by our Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the site.
